feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 26 November 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing. Risk of gales later.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covering the Irish Sea will decline as Atlantic fronts then arrive later today.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 4 or 5, veering and increasing South or Southeast 5 or 6 this morning, increasing 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreading from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southeast 6 or 7, veering and decreasing West 3 or 4 in west of area late in night. Becoming Variable 2 to 4 in most waters tomorrow morning, but still Southeast 5 or 6 in east. Settling Southeast 2 to 4 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow afternoon, then slight in the evening.


##Weather##

Rain, soon becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
